Strategy: Best Fit scoring plus a bonus when the leftover falls in either 5 to 15 or 45 to 55, so two separate residual bands outrank slightly tighter bins outside them. The ranking differs from Best Fit only when the tightest leftover is outside both bands. It may help by targeting two reusable residual sizes at once, or fail because maintaining two bands splits placements across incompatible targets.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) + (70 if (r - item >= 5 and r - item <= 15) or (r - item >= 45 and r - item <= 55) else 0)) for r in bins]
```
